title: EmpAItica: AI-Based Prediction of Fear Responses in Spider Phobia Using Virtual Reality (VR)
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate whether an artificial intelligence (AI) model can distinguish between individuals with and without a diagnosed spider phobia based on their physiological responses during a standardized virtual reality (VR) exposure. To achieve this, physiological measures such as heart rate, skin conductance, respiration, and movement patterns will be recorded and compared with the results of a psychological diagnostic assessment. In addition, the study will explore factors that may be associated with a more favorable response to the exposure procedure.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adequate German language skills to provide informed consent and understand all study instructions and questionnaires.
Exclusion criteria:
Neurological disorders
Cardiovascular diseases
Uncorrected visual impairments
Intolerance to virtual reality applications (VR intolerance/cybersickness)
Pregnancy
Acute suicidality
Psychotic symptoms or psychotic disorders
High dissociative tendency
Substance abuse
Bipolar disorder
Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
Current use of psychotropic medication
